note: Gap-filling layer. Every cell filled, every cell labelled. Contains NO fabricated observations and NO synthetic respondent text.

oq_estimates.topic: Official IIC count is unverifiable
oq_estimates.estimate: 14,067 - 16,367 (three official values, 16.4% spread)
oq_estimates.method: Three T1 sources (AIM 2024-07-31; IIC portal 2025; MoE status page 2025-26). No counting rule stated by any.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A single authority publishes a counting definition (registered / active / submitted).
oq_estimates.decision: Size off the floor (14,067) for planning and cite the ceiling for the bull case. Never publish one number.

oq_estimates.topic: AICTE approved-institution count
oq_estimates.estimate: Not published as a single figure; ~1,168 universities + 45,473 colleges is the AISHE frame, not the AICTE frame
oq_estimates.method: AICTE regulates a different population than AISHE surveys. Overlap unknown; neither figure is the AICTE total.
oq_estimates.moves_if: AICTE publishes an approved-institution register with a count.
oq_estimates.decision: Do not use an AICTE count anywhere. Use AISHE and say it is AISHE.

oq_estimates.topic: Willingness to pay
oq_estimates.estimate: Probability a target institution will sign at Rs 1.2L/yr: 8%-35% (median ~18%)
oq_estimates.method: Monte Carlo over triangular priors on ACV (Rs 60k-1.5L), committee-exposure (Phase 2: Rs 50k-10L spread), and incumbent-satisfaction. Seeded; see data_p36_simulation.
oq_estimates.moves_if: One documented budget-head conversation (OQ-29) OR one signed quote.
oq_estimates.decision: Below 8%: do not sell institutionally - sell the IPR module to individuals or pivot to incubation centres (G5). Above 35%: raise price and open the college segment (G1) commercially.

oq_estimates.topic: No public API in the mandated stack
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: IIC portal, NIRF and ARIIA have no documented public write API
oq_estimates.method: Phase 3A read 11 published forms and the IIC portal; no API surface is published for any of the three.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A vendor documents an API that reads the IIC portal successfully.
oq_estimates.decision: Product must be import-first, not sync-first. Budget integration as a services line, not a feature.

oq_estimates.topic: Rival datasets disagree on AIC/TBI counts
oq_estimates.estimate: 4 different AIC counts and 3 TBI counts across sources; spread is 3-6x
oq_estimates.method: Cross-source comparison; AIM publishes selected-EIC lists without a total.
oq_estimates.moves_if: AIM publishes a consolidated register.
oq_estimates.decision: Cite AIM directly for anything AIC-related. Never aggregate incubator counts across sources.

oq_estimates.topic: UGC and AISHE use different frames for 'university'
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed divergence; AISHE counts 1,168, UGC's list differs in scope
oq_estimates.method: AISHE is a survey of registered institutions; UGC is an approval body. Frames are not interchangeable.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A reconciliation note is published by either body.
oq_estimates.decision: State the frame in every citation. Do not mix UGC and AISHE counts in one calculation.

oq_estimates.topic: Autonomous college count
oq_estimates.estimate: Not separately published; bounded by 45,473 colleges, realistically 5-10% -> 2,300-4,500
oq_estimates.method: AISHE does not disaggregate autonomy. The 5-10% band is an analyst prior on Indian autonomous-college share.
oq_estimates.moves_if: AICTE or UGC publishes an autonomous-institution list.
oq_estimates.decision: Segment G2 sizing is population-insensitive - it is limited by budget, not by count. Do not over-invest in precision here.

oq_estimates.topic: Incubator/accelerator counts are login-gated
oq_estimates.estimate: 244 seed-funded incubators (T1, NSD26); SISFS-selected 217 (T1, PIB)
oq_estimates.method: Public press releases. The full Startup India register is gated but the funded subset is not.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An ungated register appears.
oq_estimates.decision: Use 244 as the funded-incubator ceiling and 217 as the SISFS-active figure. Segment G5 sizing is bounded by these, not by the gated total.

oq_estimates.topic: Almost no independent review evidence in this market
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed absence across G2/Capterra/search in Phase 0
oq_estimates.method: Phase 0 competitor scan of 15 vendors found no independent review corpus for Indian institutional innovation software.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A review platform accumulates Indian HEI software reviews.
oq_estimates.decision: There is no social proof to compete against. Differentiation must be structural (the join defect), not testimonial.

oq_estimates.topic: IIC star-rating formula is not public
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: the 1-5 band is published, the formula is not
oq_estimates.method: MoE Innovation Cell material describes the band and the 50% weightage for minimum calendar activities, but no scoring formula.
oq_estimates.moves_if: The methodology document is published.
oq_estimates.decision: Stars are unusable as a benchmark input. Do not model on them - this is why IP Depth is UNKNOWN in Phase 4.

oq_estimates.topic: BHASKAR overhaul - real threat or noise?
oq_estimates.estimate: 60% real, 40% communication: the platform exists and is live, but no institution has been observed migrating to it
oq_estimates.method: Platform verifiably exists (Startup India, 660,000+ registered users). Adoption is unobserved. Analyst prior.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A single institution describes BHASKAR as its current system of record.
oq_estimates.decision: If a nodal officer names BHASKAR, the integration-first thesis collapses and the import-first thesis strengthens. Do not build against BHASKAR before someone names it.

oq_estimates.topic: No peer-reviewed literature on Indian institutional reporting burden
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed absence in the searched indexes
oq_estimates.method: No paper found quantifying IIC/NIRF reporting hours. The burden is therefore established only by our own 36-document corpus.
oq_estimates.moves_if: Any paper measures hours per submission cycle.
oq_estimates.decision: This is a publishable gap in itself. Our corpus is currently the only quantified account.

oq_estimates.topic: Can an institution-facing product even be bought easily?
oq_estimates.estimate: Committee threshold Rs 50,000-10,00,000 across 8 instruments (20x spread); 4 of 25 roles hold documented authority
oq_estimates.method: Phase 2 procurement analysis of 8 institutional instruments.
oq_estimates.moves_if: OQ-26/OQ-27 answer whether GeM bypasses committees generally.
oq_estimates.decision: Price below the LOWEST observed threshold (Rs 50,000) if a fast direct-purchase route is required. Rs 1.2L forces a committee at most institutions - this is the single biggest commercial constraint.

oq_estimates.topic: States with a startup policy are login-gated
oq_estimates.estimate: 32 of 36 States/UTs (T1, NSD26)
oq_estimates.method: Public figure from Startup India's 10-year fact figures.
oq_estimates.moves_if: The state list is published ungated.
oq_estimates.decision: Use 32/36 for national-rollout reasoning. It is sufficient.

oq_estimates.topic: University/technology-transfer software only partly researched
oq_estimates.estimate: Partial: 15 competitors scanned, TTO software underweighted in the scan
oq_estimates.method: Phase 0 competitor set skews to student-innovation management. Pure TTO/IPM suites were not systematically compared.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A dedicated TTO-software scan finds a product covering patent lifecycle end to end.
oq_estimates.decision: Treat the 'no competitor has full IPR lifecycle' claim as scoped to the 15 scanned vendors. Say 'scanned', not 'none exist'.

oq_estimates.topic: Hindi/regional UI is claimed by almost nobody
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: 1 of 15 competitors claims regional-language support, and it is unverified
oq_estimates.method: Phase 0 competitor feature matrix.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A major vendor ships verified regional UI.
oq_estimates.decision: Cheap differentiator, low defensibility. Build it, do not lead with it.

oq_estimates.topic: Campus ERP channel risk
oq_estimates.estimate: Moderate: an ERP incumbent could bundle equivalent functionality
oq_estimates.method: No ERP vendor was found shipping startup/IP tracking in Phase 0. Risk is strategic, not observed.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An ERP vendor (e.g. an Indian higher-ed suite) ships a startup module.
oq_estimates.decision: Target the join defect, which ERP vendors structurally will not fix - it needs a founder-side identifier ERP does not hold. That is the defensible position.

oq_estimates.topic: Incu (Sweden) tracks patents as a data field
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: patents-as-field exists in at least one international product
oq_estimates.method: Phase 0 competitor scan.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A direct competitor ships full patent lifecycle in India.
oq_estimates.decision: Do not claim patents-as-a-field is novel. Claim the LIFECYCLE and the IIC/ARIIA derivation are, which no competitor has.

oq_estimates.topic: 'Ideas generated' has no common definition
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: no cross-institution benchmark is possible on this metric
oq_estimates.method: Phase 1 corpus: the same field means different things across 36 institutions; range 2-843.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A government definition is published.
oq_estimates.decision: Never build a benchmark, a score or a leaderboard on self-reported counts. This is the whole thesis.

oq_estimates.topic: Which figure wins when narrative and KPI form disagree?
oq_estimates.estimate: Nominally the KPI form; empirically neither - both are wrong
oq_estimates.method: NIT Calicut reports 55 and 17 in one document; Teresa's typed a grant narrative into a numeric field.
oq_estimates.moves_if: Phase 3 shows nobody reconciles the two (OQ-34).
oq_estimates.decision: Treat any institution-reported count as unattributed until two sources agree. StartupHub's value is agreement, not collection.

oq_estimates.topic: Corpus may be unrepresentative
oq_estimates.estimate: Biased toward publishing institutions, therefore toward BETTER-documented and likely BETTER-resourced ones
oq_estimates.method: All 36 institutions self-published. Non-publishers are absent by construction.
oq_estimates.moves_if: Non-publishing institutions enter the corpus.
oq_estimates.decision: Findings are LOWER BOUNDS on the problem. Institutions that do not publish are almost certainly worse, not better. This makes the wedge argument conservative, not overstated.

oq_estimates.topic: Actual IIC filing rate - most may never file
oq_estimates.estimate: 20%-45% of registered IICs submit a usable report; 7 of 36 in our corpus report no activity at all
oq_estimates.method: Our corpus is 36 self-published reports. Within it, 7 (19%) report zero activity metrics and 14 (39%) lack either activity or startup data. Extrapolated to the 14,067-16,367 registered population.
oq_estimates.moves_if: IIC portal publishes submission statistics.
oq_estimates.decision: The effective market is the filing minority, not the registered count. TAM uses 14,067-16,367; SAM uses 777 who actually filed. This is why the SAM band is 16x wide.

oq_estimates.topic: International IP filings have no home in the schema
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: neither NIRF Innovation nor ARIIA carries an international-filing field
oq_estimates.method: Phase 3A field-by-field read of 7 NIRF and 4 ARIIA forms.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A schema change adds one.
oq_estimates.decision: This is a structural gap no competitor addresses and the government does not model. Strongest single differentiator for the IPR module.

oq_estimates.topic: Is the grant field ever validated?
oq_estimates.estimate: No. It has demonstrably absorbed the wrong money
oq_estimates.method: Dr. N.G.P.'s grant figure reconciles to two unrelated DBT grants (P-A09); Teresa's narrative fill (P-A02).
oq_estimates.moves_if: Any institution describes grant-field validation.
oq_estimates.decision: Treat institution grant data as unusable. Never compute ROI from it.

oq_estimates.topic: No national HEI procurement standard
oq_estimates.estimate: Confirmed: 20x spread in committee triggers across 8 instruments
oq_estimates.method: Phase 2 procurement ladder analysis.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A mandatory central procurement circular is issued.
oq_estimates.decision: Assume every institution has its own rule. Price below Rs 50,000 for a fast route; expect a committee above it.

oq_estimates.topic: Does the IIC Convener hold a budget line?
oq_estimates.estimate: Probability a Convener can initiate a purchase independently: 10%-30%
oq_estimates.method: Prior conditioned on Phase 2: 0 of 12 Class A IIC seats hold documented budget authority; 4 of 25 roles do overall, none Class A. Monte Carlo over role-class and committee-threshold exposure.
oq_estimates.moves_if: One Convener describes initiating a purchase without escalation (OQ-29).
oq_estimates.decision: Below 10%: enter through the Registrar (G3/G8), not the Convener. Above 30%: the Convener is a viable first call and the sales cycle shortens materially.

oq_estimates.topic: Is GeM a committee bypass or an NIT carve-out?
oq_estimates.estimate: General for universities/NITs that hold a GeM-enabled account; 40%-70%
oq_estimates.method: Observed at NIT Warangal (Phase 2). Whether it generalises is unverified. Analyst prior informed by GeM's ₹51,000 crore of recorded startup orders (T1).
oq_estimates.moves_if: A second institution describes a GeM-routed purchase bypassing its committee.
oq_estimates.decision: If general, the fastest route is a GeM listing, not a committee pitch. If it is a carve-out, expect the full 20x-threshold spread. This single question changes the go-to-market route.

oq_estimates.topic: Is the Convener the same person as the Incubation Manager?
oq_estimates.estimate: Likely yes at smaller institutions; split at NIT/IIT tier
oq_estimates.method: Corpus type mix (9 engineering + 6 autonomous colleges vs 4 NITs) suggests staffing depth scales with tier. Analyst prior.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An institution names both roles and states whether one person holds them.
oq_estimates.decision: If one person: the integration point is real and selling is single-threaded. If split: expect two spreadsheets and a reconciliation problem - which is the product, but doubles the entry cost.

oq_estimates.topic: Which budget head does the money come from?
oq_estimates.estimate: Predominantly general institutional revenue or a scheme-linked grant; rarely a dedicated innovation-software line
oq_estimates.method: Zero documented budget head for innovation software across 8 procurement instruments and 25 roles. ARIIA's only money signal is retrospective expenditure (F-ARIIA-FUND-SPLIT). Analyst prior informed by the 3,200+ private unaided colleges with no discretionary fund.
oq_estimates.moves_if: Any institution names the head on the record.
oq_estimates.decision: Assume no line exists. Therefore sell against a COMPLIANCE EVENT (a dated filing), not a budget cycle. This is D-007 restated as a planning assumption rather than an inference.

oq_estimates.topic: Does the IT Administrator have a veto?
oq_estimates.estimate: Formal veto: 20%-40%. Practical veto (can stall indefinitely): 60%-80%
oq_estimates.method: IT Administrator appears in 0 of 8 procurement instruments by name. Practical veto is inferred from Phase 0's finding that data-localisation and on-premise deployment are near-universal conditions.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An institution describes an IT approval step that delayed or killed a purchase.
oq_estimates.decision: Budget for a security questionnaire and on-premise option from day one regardless of the formal answer. Cheap insurance against a high practical veto.

oq_estimates.topic: Was the corrupt Phase 0 'segment census' file ever valid?
oq_estimates.estimate: Probably a mis-saved binary; no Phase 0 conclusion rests on it
oq_estimates.method: The 2.34 MB artefact was 74% binary, began %PDF-1.7 and contained no readable text. The 20-row segment_census.csv rebuilds cleanly from the live data modules.
oq_estimates.moves_if: A shell-history record shows the crawl actually ran.
oq_estimates.decision: No action. The affected numbers are already regenerated from source. Recorded in _quarantine/.

oq_estimates.topic: How does a nodal officer obtain a founder's DPIIT number?
oq_estimates.estimate: Three modes, roughly equal: (a) a maintained list they or the institute keeps, (b) asking the founder, (c) looking it up on the DPIIT portal
oq_estimates.method: Phase 3A proved the join fails (32/354, 9.0%; worst 67%). Placeholder DIPP0000 keys in 3 of 7 NIRF forms suggest a maintained list that is incomplete. The three modes are the natural closure of a failed join.
oq_estimates.moves_if: One officer describes the actual mechanism.
oq_estimates.decision: If (a): StartupHub is a better spreadsheet - thin differentiation. If (b) or (c): the product must carry founder-side capture - strong differentiation. The difference is the whole product, which is why it is the highest-value interview question.

oq_estimates.topic: What does the officer type when the key is missing?
oq_estimates.estimate: Blank in ~50%, placeholder (DIPP0000-style) in ~35%, drops the row in ~15%
oq_estimates.method: Placeholder keys appear in 3 of 7 NIRF forms (43%). Blanks dominate ARIIA (IIT Kanpur leaves the 2019-20 star cell blank). Row-drop is inferred from the join loss exceeding the placeholder count.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An officer demonstrates the behaviour on their real form.
oq_estimates.decision: If blank-dominant: the ledger is lossy silently, which is our strongest privacy-preserving pitch. If placeholder-dominant: the ledger is visibly corrupt, which is our strongest urgency pitch. Either way we win - but the pitch differs.

oq_estimates.topic: Does anyone reconcile NIRF against ARIIA?
oq_estimates.estimate: Probability that any given institution reconciles the two: under 20%
oq_estimates.method: Incompatible time grains (ARIIA academic-year pairs vs NIRF single cycle), different nodal officers, and zero reconciliation artefacts in 36 documents or 11 forms. No institution in the corpus shows a cross-referenced count.
oq_estimates.moves_if: An institution describes comparing the two numbers.
oq_estimates.decision: If nobody reconciles, a single portfolio layer is a genuine new capability rather than a better spreadsheet. If they do reconcile, it is a consolidation play with weaker differentiation.

hypothesis_priors.basis: P-A01/P-A06 are DOCUMENTED on fragmentation but the absence of a register is inference. F-SENTINEL-ZERO and the 7-of-36 zero-activity institutions pull down; the fact that all 36 produced SOME report pulls up.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An officer opens an existing system holding a venture list: prior -> 0.20. A named spreadsheet that is not the form: prior -> 0.85.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.35: StartupHub is a registry, and registries are low willingness-to-pay. Above 0.75: StartupHub is a reconciliation layer, which is where the Phase 3A join finding lands.

hypothesis_priors.claim: The NIRF DPIIT join breaks in practice
hypothesis_priors.basis: 32/354 measured across 7 published forms; reverse gap in a 4th. Documentary, not inferred.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An officer says the join works because they hold the numbers: prior -> 0.45.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.6: the headline finding is a form-design artefact nobody feels, and the wedge weakens to a data-quality feature.

hypothesis_priors.basis: Universal in Indian institutional admin and the corpus shows hand-assembly (P-A08), but no institution has been observed. The pricing model rests entirely on this.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An institution already pays for a system doing this: prior -> 0.25. An officer names only free tools: prior -> 0.90.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.4: there is no free incumbent and the competitive comparison is wrong - reprice against paid incumbents, not against Excel.

hypothesis_priors.claim: Coordinated deadlines are the forcing event
hypothesis_priors.basis: Teresa's 13-item narrative in a numeric field (P-A02) and ARIIA '0 (On Progress)' sentinels are deadline artefacts. That work is happening proves the pressure.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An officer describes continuous work with no deadline pressure: prior -> 0.40.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Above 0.7: sell against the filing date and the product has a natural expiry per cycle. Below 0.5: no trigger exists and the go-to-market must originate elsewhere.

hypothesis_priors.claim: The Convener is or can reach the buyer
hypothesis_priors.basis: Phase 2: 0 of 12 Class A IIC seats hold documented budget authority. The paperwork contradicts the pitch, which is why this prior starts low rather than neutral.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: A Convener describes initiating a purchase unaided: prior -> 0.75.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.45: enter through the Registrar. This is the decision with the largest go-to-market consequence in the set.

hypothesis_priors.claim: Convener and Incubation Manager are one person
hypothesis_priors.basis: Corpus type mix implies staffing depth scales with tier; smaller institutions almost certainly combine the roles.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: Named as separate people with separate spreadsheets: prior -> 0.30.
hypothesis_priors.decision: If combined: single-threaded sale, integration cost low. If split: two sources of truth, which is the product but doubles entry cost.

hypothesis_priors.claim: Rs 1.2 lakh sits inside a plausible budget range
hypothesis_priors.basis: Rs 1.2L exceeds the LOWEST observed committee trigger (Rs 50,000) by 2.4x, and 0 of 25 roles hold documented authority for it. The only anchor is a competitor's Rs 75,000 price for a different scope.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: A Registrar names a budget head that covers this: prior -> 0.70.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.35: reprice to sub-Rs-50,000 for a direct-purchase route, or move upmarket to G5/G3. This is the pricing decision the whole plan hangs on.

hypothesis_priors.basis: P-A03 is graded HYPOTHESIS. Cohort language is absent across 36 documents - absence of evidence, and incubators (G5) do use the concept, which is why it is not lower.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An institution describes grouping ventures into a batch: prior -> 0.80.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Below 0.35: DROP cohort management from the product. It has no forcing event (OQ-22/OQ-34 pattern) and would be an unrequested feature.

hypothesis_priors.claim: IPR tracking is a real institutional problem
hypothesis_priors.basis: P-A07 is DOCUMENTED CRITICAL: 0 of 36 institutions keep a deadline calendar, against 91,168 national filings in 2023-24. But an outside TTO or agency may handle it, which is the counter-argument.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: An institution describes tracking patents internally: prior -> 0.85. Agency/TTO handles it: prior -> 0.25.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Above 0.6: the IPR module leads, because it is the only one with a hard external deadline. Below 0.4: reporting stays the wedge and IPR becomes a later module.

hypothesis_priors.claim: On-premise / data-localisation is a near-universal condition
hypothesis_priors.basis: Phase 0 found data localisation and on-premise near-universal in competitor filtering; IT Administrator is in 0 of 8 procurement instruments by name.
hypothesis_priors.moves_if: A cloud SaaS product clears procurement unchallenged: prior -> 0.30.
hypothesis_priors.decision: Above 0.55: ship on-premise from day one. It roughly doubles deployment cost and it is the price of being in the room.

portfolio.method: G1 is 65.3% private unaided with no documented discretionary fund. H-07 prior is 0.35. Sub-Rs-50,000 keeps a fast direct-purchase route below the lowest observed committee trigger.
portfolio.moves_if: OQ-29 names a fund, or H-07 moves above 0.7.
portfolio.decision: This is the price to test first in G1, NOT the Rs 1.2 lakh list price.

portfolio.method: Committee-exercised but funded. Phase 2's Rs 50k-10L spread centres around committee territory.
portfolio.moves_if: OQ-27 resolves (GeM bypass) - a GeM route could push effective realisation to list.
portfolio.decision: Test Rs 1.2 lakh here first. It is the segment where the join finding is demonstrable to the exact buyer.

portfolio.method: AIM grant-in-aid up to Rs 10 crore; 244 funded incubators are commercial entities with procurement capacity and no competitor class to displace.
portfolio.moves_if: OQ-08 resolves to a larger ungated register, or a named incubator states a budget.
portfolio.decision: Highest value per deal, fewest deals available (244 ceiling). Not a volume segment.

portfolio.value: Rs 14.2 - Rs 26.5 lakh (P25-P75); median Rs 21 lakh
portfolio.method: Monte Carlo, seed 20261019, 50,000 trials over triangular priors on realised ACV, conversion, reachable institutions, renewal and sales cycle. See data_p36_simulation.
portfolio.moves_if: Conversion (r=0.65) and ACV (r=0.56) dominate; capacity (r=0.47) is third.
portfolio.decision: Below Rs 14L: the institution-only model does not carry a team. Above Rs 27L: fund a second sales hire.

portfolio.metric: Probability of reaching Rs 1 crore ARR by year 3 (institutions only)
portfolio.value: 0.0% (0 of 50,000 trials; P95 = Rs 41 lakh, max = Rs 54 lakh)
portfolio.method: CORRECTION. An earlier hand-written estimate in this repository said 18-34%. The seeded simulation falsified it. Reaching Rs 1 crore needs ~120 paying institutions at Rs 1.8 lakh each, which is 15% of the entire 777-institution SAM floor converted via founder-led sales in 3 years. Not credible.
portfolio.moves_if: Requires a structural change, not a better conversion rate: higher ACV (a second revenue line), a longer horizon, or a non-institution buyer.
portfolio.decision: Do not plan an institution-only path to Rs 1 crore. Either add the IPR module sold to researchers, or enter incubation centres (G5) where ACV is 3-4x higher on a 244-institution ceiling. This is the single most important number the simulation produced, and it changed our recommendation.

portfolio.method: Reachable (150-600) x conversion (0.02-0.20). Consistent with the Phase 7 SOM envelope of 15-25.
portfolio.decision: 19-31 institutions is a real, fundable business. It is not a Rs 1 crore business.

portfolio.metric: Realised ACV per institution per year
portfolio.method: Triangular prior Rs 35k / Rs 95k / Rs 180k after discounting, pilots and partial years.
portfolio.moves_if: OQ-03 / OQ-29 naming an actual budget head.
portfolio.decision: Below Rs 75k: reprice the product. Above Rs 1.2L: the list price is defensible.

portfolio.metric: Which unknown most widens the answer
portfolio.method: Correlation against year-3 ARR across trials. Three inputs are near-irrelevant to ARR at year 3: on-premise demand (r=0.01), renewal (r=0.01) and sales cycle (r=0.00) - renewal does not affect year-3 revenue at all.
portfolio.moves_if: A structural change in the revenue model.
portfolio.decision: Measure conversion and ACV first; do NOT spend research effort on renewal or sales-cycle length, which do not change the year-3 answer.

portfolio.method: Founder-led sale into a committee-gated buyer with a January NIRF deadline. The deadline compresses the cycle if timing is right.
portfolio.moves_if: A GeM listing is confirmed as a committee bypass (OQ-27) - this could halve it.
portfolio.decision: Sell INTO a deadline, not after one. The 31 January NIRF date is the anchor.

acv_realised.metric: Realised ACV per institution per year

arr_per_logo.metric: Year-1 ARR per logo including renewal
